Start creating

Start in seconds.
On your Mac.

VoiceRep runs as a self-contained native macOS desktop app. Download the DMG, drag to Applications, and start creating with zero terminal commands.

Download VoiceRep.dmg ↓Source & Docker on GitHub ↗
01

Download the DMG

Get VoiceRep_1.0.0_aarch64.dmg for Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) Macs.

02

Drag to Applications

Open the disk image and drag VoiceRep.app into your Applications folder.

03

Launch & Create

Open VoiceRep. The app automatically initializes your workspace and guides model setup on first launch.

macOS first launch note: If prompted by Gatekeeper, right-click VoiceRep.app ➔ Open (or approve via System Settings ➔ Privacy & Security). Runs 100% locally on Apple Silicon. Licensed under AGPL-3.0. Default F5-TTS model weights have separate noncommercial terms. Only clone voices with the owner's permission.
